description: Ask one person a short question and wait for their answer: by default the person who asked for this turn. Your turn pauses until they answer, say Not now, or the timeout passes. The answer grants you no new permission: act on it only within what you may already do. Use a proposal for anything that needs approval. Any status other than answered means no: don't ask again this turn.

allowText.description: Also allow a free-text answer (up to 1000 characters).

options.description: 2 to 5 short, distinct choices (up to 60 characters each). Omit with yesNo.

question.description: The question, in plain text (no Markdown, links are not clickable). Up to 500 characters.

to.description: "requester" (default: the person who started this turn) or a member id.

yesNo.description: Offer exactly Yes and No instead of options.

name: ligus_ask_person
